provider: Terra Analog, derived from NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 with the GSHHG land mask
product_version: K-005 v2 land-masked features; ETOPO_2022_v1 15 arc-second surface

sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.title: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, surface elevation tiles
sources.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, surface elevation tiles. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74.
sources.role: Earth surface elevation input. GSHHG ocean/water samples are excluded before area-averaging land heights to the regional metric grid; absolute elevation is not a cross-body scoring feature.

sources.provider: Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith, SOEST University of Hawai'i and NOAA
sources.title: Global Self-consistent, Hierarchical, High-resolution Geography Database
sources.citation: Wessel, P. and W. H. F. Smith. Global Self-consistent, Hierarchical, High-resolution Geography Database (GSHHG), version 2.3.7. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7007502.
sources.role: Independent land/water mask. L1/L3 land, L2/L4 water, L5 excluded, L6 grounded Antarctic land.

temporal_coverage.missing_reason: Static terrain surface; no single acquisition interval is provided.

grid.mask_id: GSHHG-2.3.7 source land-only, target L1-L4-L6 land-center; land fraction sampled at 4x
grid.vertical_reference: EGM2008 geoid in source ETOPO; scored features are relative terrain measures.

steps: Verify input file size and SHA-256 against the pinned K-017 source manifest.
Rasterize GSHHG L1/L3/L6 as land and L2/L4 as water at the ETOPO source posting; mask ocean and source no-data before area-averaging land heights to the metric grid.
Rasterize the independent GSHHG hierarchy on the 2,000 m target grid and estimate coastal land fraction from 4x subcell centre samples.
Retain the centre-based land candidate rule; no bathymetry is used as a land elevation sample.
Compute slope with metric 2,000 m gradients; compute local-plane roughness and P95-P05 relief in a 10,000 m circular window.
Retain every AOI cell with stable row/column ID; store unavailable measurements as blank CSV fields with QA reason.

parameters.aoi_candidate_rule: Cell centre is inside the declared regional bbox; margin cells support local windows but are not candidates.
parameters.pixel_area_measurement: WGS84 ellipsoidal polygon area from each cell's four UTM-transformed corners; regional coverage areas sum these pixel areas.
parameters.elevation_resampling: average of GSHHG land-only source samples; ocean and source no-data are excluded before resampling
parameters.nodata_policy: Missing or non-land samples reduce support; no interpolation or zero fill.

qa_rules: is_land_center is independent of ETOPO elevation and uses GSHHG hierarchy.
land_fraction_4x is a 4x subcell-centre estimate, not an exact polygon area fraction.
slope requires all 9 cells in its 3x3 neighbourhood to be land with finite DEM.
roughness_m and relief_m require at least 73 of 81 expected cells in the 10 km disk to be finite land DEM samples.
A cell is eligible only when it is centre-land and all three feature values are present.
Exclusion reasons are mutually exclusive and sum with eligible_pixels to total_pixels.
Ocean bathymetry is excluded before ETOPO resampling; all unmeasured CSV values are empty strings and zero is never a missing-data sentinel.
quality.nodata_convention: Empty CSV cell plus is_eligible=false and missing_reason; source no-data remains NaN during warp and is never filled.

limitations: This is a set of regional candidate cells, not a global search or proof of a global optimum.
A local UTM grid is used only within each declared AOI; pixels from different regional grid versions are not mixed into one ranking.
2 km is the analytical cell and effective output scale; ETOPO source posting is approximately 0.42–0.46 km at these latitudes and aggregation does not add source detail.
The candidate rule uses cell centres in an AOI bbox, so edge cells can extend outside the bbox; the bbox and rule are explicit.
The source land mask follows GSHHG polygon centres at the 15 arc-second ETOPO posting; the separate 4x target-cell land fraction can miss sub-500 m islands or narrow coastline features.
NASADEM's SRTM latitude coverage and its vertical conversion are not used for this ETOPO feature package; NASADEM is an independent validation source in K-017.
